title: Customer order tracking page
problem: The SMS tracking link pointed to a page that did not exist, so customers kept calling.
now: Customers open the link, type their mobile number and see the steps, courier, tracking ID, cash to pay and items.
steps: Open any order sent to the courier
See the steps and courier scans
notes: Where: Customer page /track?id=<order number> (SMS link, thank-you page, order page › Track)

steps.eval: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const b = document.querySelector('.mn-x'); if (!b) break; b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); } })()
